script = """import sqlite3, json

conn = sqlite3.connect('/workspace/world.db')
conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row

# Get cart
cart_row = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM carts WHERE customer_id = 'user_fbab7801'").fetchone()
if not cart_row:
    print("No cart found")
else:
    cart = dict(cart_row)
    print("CART:", json.dumps(cart, indent=2))

    # Get cart items
    items = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM cart_items WHERE customer_id = 'user_fbab7801'").fetchall()
    items_list = [dict(r) for r in items]
    print("ITEMS:", json.dumps(items_list, indent=2))

    # Get product details for each item
    prod_ids = [i['product_id'] for i in items_list]
    placeholders = ','.join('?' * len(prod_ids))
    products = conn.execute(f"SELECT product_id, name, current_price, category FROM products WHERE product_id IN ({placeholders})", prod_ids).fetchall()
    print("PRODUCTS:", json.dumps([dict(p) for p in products], indent=2))

conn.close()
"""
